After the325 dependency settles, exact final-source review, current-base hosted required checks, final intended formal receipt/original16-log bindings and actual protections/overlap checks remain work. ## Historical creation description — preserved verbatim

## Change and purpose

Reject an unsupported Lean runtime before deleting the existing build output or running build/replay/audit/control work. The old substring check accepted records such as4.34.10 and4.34.1-rc1 and ran only after that work.

The gate now uses one anchored exact-release predicate for both the new preflight and retained final check. It preserves the final source/digest checks and receipt schema. A separate `preflight-version.log` joins the existing dynamically hashed logs; `version.log` and receipt `lean_version` still describe the final observation.

This is the main-only engineering repair in [offer6066660506](https://github.com/d6g8k5htny-coder/main/issues/307#issuecomment-6066660506), using the [actual predecessor diagnostic6066278094](https://github.com/d6g8k5htny-coder/main/issues/307#issuecomment-6066278094). Exactly three files change. The manifest refreshes only the gate/test hashes.

## Current disposition

- Draft head: `2ae140cdb17e43a9102fee9fea3bea12dd91c5b4`; parent `43da2b812b4aca93136afb41335b6273f2ed3391`; tree `f86bc563bf0dd33757fe46b89e24a00cc8d57208`
- Actual author: OpenAI/Codex `audit_lean_toolchain_contract`, receiver `main-lean-preflight-author-20261008`, token `MAIN-LEAN-PREFLIGHT-R1-20261008T1841Z`
- Claim: [personal pickup6066772816](https://github.com/d6g8k5htny-coder/main/issues/307#issuecomment-6066772816), actual native start18:48:21UTC; [successful post-read/crossing qualification6066785564](https://github.com/d6g8k5htny-coder/main/issues/307#issuecomment-6066785564)
- Source-author work is complete and custody is released with this draft. Integration owner: none. A distinct nonauthor candidate review and protected integration are next
- Existing runtime-reader feedback covered naming/order/consumer design only. No candidate approval, scientific alignment or historical-owner assent is claimed
- Hosted checks: not yet assessed at creation; exact-current-commit formal execution and existing required checks remain required

## Verification

Actual local runtime: CPython3.12.14; Git2.52.0. This is distinct from the hosted Python3.11 lane.

- Original baseline:43 formal test methods in normal and optimized modes, each OK with one explicit real-Lean skip
- TDD RED: the six new regression methods on the unchanged gate failed22 assertions/subtests in each mode, exit1, with no harness errors. Failures expose the permissive predicate, late build deletion and missing first version boundary
- GREEN: the six new methods pass in both modes; the complete formal suite is49 methods per mode, OK with the same single real-Lean skip
- Complete applicable Python discovery: `python3 -B -S -m unittest discover -s tests -v` and `python3 -B -O -S -m unittest discover -s tests -v`:435 methods each, OK, one real-Lean skip each
- Source-only gate passed in both modes with manifest SHA256 `26be8544377f7288170f9f124989a04dc41dc5428cf20a8de7261c35bc873a60`
- All original43 test-method ASTs are preserved. Manifest comparison confirms only the two Python hashes changed;31 targets, all ordering, seven statement controls, dependencies and scientific/alignment fields are identical
- Local checks ran on the proposed source tree above before publication. Native Git objects and the downloaded commit tree exactly match that tested tree; `git diff --check` is clean

New tests use disposable fixtures and mocked compiler/Git subprocess results. Actual gate orchestration, log writing, axiom parsing and temporary-package source checking run. These are software regressions, not Lean proof execution. They cover wrong versions at both boundaries, valid continuation, preservation of a build sentinel, final source drift, nonzero version process and timeout.

Raw RED logs are retained unchanged. Normal stderr SHA256 `3310994d2b7ba7da8de3e466f8ae13963bff287277a3c529349d9a60400c4355`; optimized stderr `ccf0be596d335a2b581b286bf03b285664c2ffcbc19d39f5dd1dd0b8571b52a8`.

## Evidence and limits

No local Lean/Lake runtime was available and none was installed. No local31-target/ten-control kernel execution is claimed. Required hosted formal evidence is separate and must be inspected at its actual tested commit.

A clean successful canonical run adds one log (15→16); the receipt's existing log map and binders accept dynamic names/counts. Evidence-directory/log creation can precede refusal. A refusal writes no new success receipt; cleanup of any pre-existing stale receipt is outside this change.

No proof, toolchain/lock, Math source/companion pin, bootstrap/cache policy, dependency-cleanliness rule, workflow or receipt schema changed. Scientific effect NONE. The author has source/consultation exposure, is not the author of the original proof/gate bytes, will not review or merge this repair, and has organizational-independence credit0.
